inquiry_text: Our employees need a digital assistant that collects information from internal tools, prepares task briefs, and suggests what to do next.
We receive scanned agreements and need important dates, obligations, and summaries extracted for staff verification.
Connect an AI capability to our existing CRM application through APIs without replacing the current software.
Our paid search campaigns need better lead quality and lower advertising costs using Google Ads performance data.
Many visitors open our pricing page but leave before signing up. We want to test page layouts and simplify the registration journey.
Build reliable backend endpoints so our customer records can be exchanged securely between the application and internal dashboard.
